## Positions

::: {.hv-timeline}

::: {.hv-tl-item .current}
[Sep 2022 – present]{.hv-date}

### PhD Researcher

[Geomicrobiology Group, University of Tübingen · DFG Emmy Noether Programme]{.hv-where}

Experimental taphonomy of morphological biosignatures from sulfur- and iron-cycling bacterial
mats under hydrothermal conditions. Also responsible for IT support and the group's website and
server databases.

*Supervisors:* Dr. Muammar Mansor, Prof. Dr. Jan-Peter Duda, Prof. Dr. Andreas Kappler
:::

::: {.hv-tl-item}
[Jan 2022 – Jul 2022]{.hv-date}

### Research Scientist

[Geomicrobiology Group, University of Tübingen, Germany]{.hv-where}

- Biogenic iron sulfide formation by sulfur-cycling microbes and microbial mats
:::

::: {.hv-tl-item}
[Sep 2019 – Dec 2021]{.hv-date}

### Scientific and Professional Associate

[NovaDerm – NeoStratum, Zagreb, Croatia]{.hv-where}

- Dermatological R&D, quality control and database management
:::

::: {.hv-tl-item}

### Research and Teaching Scientist

[Laboratory for Biological Oceanography, University of Zagreb, Croatia]{.hv-where}

- Fieldwork, eDNA metabarcoding, website, teaching and lab courses
